question: In a certain code language, 'QUALIFY' is coded as 'PTZKHYF' and 'PANTHER' is coded as 'OZMSGRE'. What is the code for 'FORCEPS' in the given code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : (1) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series. So, • 'QUALIFY' is coded as 'PTZKHYF'
